llm_response.reason: The site claims to sell Keds shoes in Colombia but the WHOIS data shows registration to an unrelated individual in China, not a Colombian entity or the official Keds company. The website provides significant discounts/free shipping, lacks appropriate business contact information, and displays no legitimate corporate presence. These factors fit multiple scam characteristics, especially #4 (non-existent companies), #5 (spoofing known products), #6 (inappropriate contact info), and #16 (mimics legitimate brand design).
